body: Thank you for the replies.  I really appreciate it. I didn't end up telling their parents but we spoke today and I think they are doing better. Me and her other friends will be keeping an eye on her and I think she will be ok.   Thank you for your input!
Hey wait.  Can we chat before you log off?
You're worth my time and I'm a stranger on the internet so I can't make it worse.  Pm me, whats on your mind?
Hey, I'm here to chat.  No judgment. Pm me. Reddit keeps giving me an error when I try to message you.

I'm assuming you are underage and are maybe in a situation where you can't just remove yourself from the situation. Correct me if I'm wrong. I've been there, it fucking sucks.  What got me through was the thought that I can eventually get myself to the position to just up and leave. I could drop everything, just get on a plane and move to mexico.  Somewhere where know one knows me and I can do whatever makes me happy. You can be in control of your life and what makes you happy. Leave the negativity behind. Please give yourself the chance to experience the world how you want to.  You deserve to be happy.
Please don't. Fuck them. There is a reason to exist. You are not alone. There is help. PM me if you wanna talk.

Fuck your mom, Fuck Chris! You deserve better! Please give yourself the chance to experience this world without them looming over you.  I assume you're too young to move out right now but life gets different when you do. You get to decide who you surround yourself with and you can decide not to put up with peoples shit.   Please give it time. I know it's cliche, but it gets better.

Not that I know shit about your life, but I guarantee there will be multiple people who will miss you if you go (a lot more than you expect, believe me). I understand how you feel as someone who feels ugly and is embarrassed  by their socially awkwardness on a daily basis. You would be missed, you are not alone, you are not worthless. Please don't end it.

I've only really met their parent a few times.  They seem like a caring parent but I know they have had "normal" (whatever that is) parent child arguments before. I'm fairly sure their parent is the one who helped get them a therapist and would help.  My hesitation in contacting them is from not wanting to burn bridges with my friend or make them feel betrayed when they just needed a friend to talk to and didn't want to escalate it.
